tokens.name: quantity-input
tokens.usage: Input direction only; inlet mark plus Input, never scientific success or provenance.

tokens.name: quantity-output
tokens.usage: Output direction only; outlet mark plus Output, never alarm or selection. Connected marks combine both roles.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Theme-aware supplied brand geometry and wordmark; never a status role.

tokens.name: brand-signal
tokens.usage: Logo orange. Result estimates use the dedicated plot-estimated token; never actions, navigation or assistant marks.

tokens.name: plot-calculated
tokens.usage: Calculated samples: solid circles in sliders, plots and result basis. Neutral ink is not a validity claim.

tokens.name: plot-estimated
tokens.usage: Estimated samples: orange outlined marks and dashed curves, with a word or legend. Not a warning or validity claim.

tokens.name: brand-ground
tokens.usage: Fixed light ground for original exported artwork; the live logo is transparent and theme-aware.

tokens.name: syntax-keyword
tokens.usage: Source keywords only; neutral ink with stronger weight, never warning colour.

tokens.name: syntax-string
tokens.usage: Source string literals only; secondary ink, never success colour.

tokens.name: syntax-number
tokens.usage: Source number literals only; secondary ink, not interaction colour.

tokens.name: focus-on-record
tokens.usage: Blue keyboard focus on the inverse historical record bar.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page ground behind panels. Steel grey, never pure white: normal state reads as grey.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, tables, dialogs. The working layer.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Read-only fields, code wells, table headers, saved values.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and panel edges. Decorative only; never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons), XDSM connection lines. Meets 3:1 on canvas, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and values on canvas, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text, table body, port names on canvas, surface, surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, units, metadata on canvas, surface, surface-sunken (≥4.9:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Interaction only: primary action, selection, links, active tab. Text on canvas, surface, accent-soft.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of accent fills and links.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, selected graph node fill, toggled controls.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (7:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, offset 2px, on every focusable element.

tokens.name: ai
tokens.usage: Assistant-originated content only: inference labels, proposal borders, the assistant mark. Text on canvas, surface, ai-soft.

tokens.name: ai-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of an assistant proposal header. Never a page or panel background.

tokens.name: on-ai
tokens.usage: Text on an ai fill (the Apply proposal button).

tokens.name: trace
tokens.usage: Provenance only: source chips, cited passages, evidence marks. Text on canvas, surface, trace-soft.

tokens.name: trace-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a source chip and of a highlighted cited passage.

tokens.name: alarm
tokens.usage: Priority 1 — failed execution, violated constraint, invalid input. Always with the diamond mark and a word.

tokens.name: alarm-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of an alarm banner or invalid field message.

tokens.name: on-alarm
tokens.usage: Text on an alarm fill (destructive confirm button).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Priority 2 — not converged, partial results, unchecked derivatives, stale assessment. With the triangle mark and a word.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a warning banner.

tokens.name: advisory
tokens.usage: Priority 3 text — unassigned input, needs review, not yet assessed. With the square mark and a word.

tokens.name: advisory-mark
tokens.usage: Fill of the advisory square only, always outlined in ink (1.6:1 alone on light).

tokens.name: advisory-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of an advisory banner or unassigned field.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Recorded success only: completed, converged, criterion met, check passed. Never a live 'normal' indicator.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a success confirmation.

tokens.name: inert
tokens.usage: Marks for not applicable, not started, none defined. Icons and outlines only (3.5:1); words use ink-muted.

tokens.name: record
tokens.usage: The historical record bar: inverse band shown whenever a frozen run or revision is open.

tokens.name: on-record
tokens.usage: Text and icons on record (13:1).

tokens.name: shell-ground
tokens.usage: Neutral outer shell.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Quiet raised working panels.

tokens.name: surface-highlight
tokens.usage: Shell chrome highlight only.

tokens.name: texture-ink
tokens.usage: Noninteractive chrome texture; never over plots or reading surfaces.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Self-hosted Manrope with system fallback. Sentence case everywhere.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: One per page: the study or record name.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Model names, panel titles in full-page views.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Blank values are missing; zero is an explicit value.

styles.name: prose
styles.sample: Compare the alternatives against the stated requirements.
styles.usage: Scientific narrative and explanatory lists; controls and numerical tables retain their own density.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Button labels, emphasized values in prose.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase field and facet labels only; set text-transform: uppercase.

groups.name: Data
groups.note: System monospace: every number, unit, identifier and line of code. Tabular figures always.

styles.name: readout-lg
styles.usage: Key outputs on a run record. At most four per view.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Values in tables, fields and inline facts.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Source editor, equations as written, identifiers like run-02.

groups.name: Dense
groups.note: Interface sans for table labels; scientific numbers retain tabular monospace.

styles.name: table
styles.usage: Body cells of tables with more than six columns.

styles.name: table-head
styles.usage: Column headers of dense tables, uppercase.

spacing.note: 4px base. Panels pad space-6 (space-4 on narrow screens); sections separate by space-6; pages gutter space-6 (space-4 below 820px).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, mark to word inside a tag.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between buttons in a group; inside tags and chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between panels in the workbench; table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; between form rows.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections; page gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above a page title; between page bands.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: XDSM matrix pitch; empty-state padding.

radius.note: Contour curves: compact chips, proportional controls, soft cards and outer shell. Scientific marks retain distinguishing shapes.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tags, chips, table cells, XDSM data cells.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, graph nodes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels, dialogs, the record bar.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Progress tracks, circular status marks and context-help triggers.

tokens.name: radius-shell
tokens.usage: Outer working canvas.

tokens.name: radius-mark
tokens.usage: Assistant square marks retain their scientific attribution shape.

shadow.note: Neutral elevation expresses workspace hierarchy, never scientific state.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the toast, the assistant when popped out.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on controls that clip outlines (graph nodes, table rows).

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Raised panels; sunken wells have no shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-shell
tokens.usage: Central canvas separation.

size.note: Two densities. Desk is the default; Floor is for touch screens and shared displays.

tokens.name: control-compact
tokens.usage: Compact button minimum height; grows for multiline labels, 48px on touch.

tokens.name: icon-control
tokens.usage: Ordinary button icon box.

tokens.name: icon-compact
tokens.usage: Compact button icon box.

tokens.name: prose-measure
tokens.usage: Maximum line length of scientific assertion prose.

tokens.name: control-desk
tokens.usage: Height of buttons, inputs and selects on desktop.

tokens.name: control-floor
tokens.usage: Height of the same controls on touch or plant-floor displays.

tokens.name: table-label-min
tokens.usage: Readable minimum for table identity columns; prose may wrap at words.

tokens.name: table-formula-min
tokens.usage: Minimum for compact error allowances; keep each dimensional term intact.

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: Default table row height.

tokens.name: row-dense
tokens.usage: Variables, samples and evaluation tables.

tokens.name: panel-inspector
tokens.usage: Width of the details panel in the model workbench.

tokens.name: panel-outline
tokens.usage: Width of the optional components list.

tokens.name: appbar-height
tokens.usage: Owner-approved shell height.

tokens.name: page-gutter
tokens.usage: Owner-approved desktop page gutter.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Workspace maximum width.

tokens.name: home-max
tokens.usage: Centered study catalogue width.

tokens.name: form-max
tokens.usage: Comfortable creation and account panel width.

tokens.name: login-max
tokens.usage: Sign-in panel width.

tokens.name: search-width
tokens.usage: Catalogue filter width.

tokens.name: dialog-max
tokens.usage: Shared dialog maximum width.

tokens.name: textarea-min
tokens.usage: Minimum text-entry well height.

tokens.name: label-gap
tokens.usage: Space from form label to control.

tokens.name: appbar-brand-min
tokens.usage: Wordmark space in the shell.

tokens.name: navigation-width
tokens.usage: Wide navigation rail.

tokens.name: navigation-collapsed-width
tokens.usage: Collapsed navigation icon rail.

tokens.name: workspace-canvas-min
tokens.usage: Central working canvas wrapping basis.

tokens.name: context-panel-width
tokens.usage: Docked scientific context reader width; stacked readers use the available width.

tokens.name: assistant-panel-width
tokens.usage: Default independent assistant dock width; resize uses bounded tenths of this token.

tokens.name: context-reader-height
tokens.usage: Docked scientific reader scroll bound.

tokens.name: texture-pitch
tokens.usage: Static shell texture spacing.
